actor.description: Current actor nickname, or the stable system key when unavailable.

target.description: Readable current target summary; empty when the target no longer exists. Never an ID or a retained order snapshot.

target_amount_fen.description: Current order amount in fen. Absent for user targets and physically deleted orders.

target_exists.description: Whether the target currently exists. Disable target details when false.

target_nickname.description: Current target user nickname, or the current order owner's nickname when available. Absent for deleted targets.

target_type.description: Target kind used to choose the order or user detail view.

bound_at.description: Original binding instant from identities.created_at; signing in again does not change it.

ip.description: The order's request IP: visible to its authenticated owner in ordinary detail and to administrators in admin detail. Never included in public lists or ordinary detail viewed by a non-owner administrator.

created_at.description: Job creation instant. This is not the timestamp of each manual request when an active job is reused.

source.description: The job's current wakeup source, such as automatic, manual, browser_return or admin_refresh. A geo job with admin_refresh forcibly rechecks current configured sources; automatic jobs must not be presented as manual requests.

province.description: Province-level stored location, or empty when unavailable. Full location is restricted to the admin detail route.

reconciliations.description: Admin detail only: all persisted distinct manual reconciliation requests, newest first. IDs are stored request UUIDs, not idempotency keys. Several requests may share a job; status/result reflect the currently linked job. Absent from ordinary owner detail and after physical deletion.

action.description: refresh_location queues a forced geo lookup after confirmation, including legacy orders. Success replaces the saved location, failure preserves it; payment state is unchanged. Missing targets return not_found, disabled geo mode returns disabled without queuing. Active refresh tasks are reused.

is_mine.description: Whether this record belongs to the effective authenticated session. Always false for guests; no owner user ID is exposed. Public feeds still contain only paid, non-hidden orders.

province.description: Stored province-level location only, or an empty string when lookup data is unavailable.

provider_details.description: Public sign-in IDs, names and icons. kind is the stable stored identity type; use id for login, binding and callback routes.

info.description: Same-origin semantic GET/POST API. Write requests require Origin and X-CSRF-Token. See docs/backend-design.md for permissions and business codes.
